description: Fires on the empty board, at the very start of the game before any stone is played (about 97% of its firing). Any stone on the board almost always turns it off; the rare exceptions are scattered mid-game positions just above threshold with no shared pattern found.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.02 on the empty board and several mid-game positions.
notes: Examples bands 5-9 over 4 seeds were almost all the empty board (act 2.322). Score 1 (ply==0): F1 0.986, P 1.00, R 0.972, AUROC 0.986, simulation share 0.01 (unit has almost no causal effect, so little to recover). 3% of firing = noisy mid-game positions (1.9-2.1) with no pattern. No synthesis beat dev max 2.723 (best: empty board 2.322). Could be a positional/start-token feature.
